newsitem.title: SPAIN: Ford Espana asks for 5,766 temporary lay-offs.
newsitem.headline: Ford Espana asks for 5,766 temporary lay-offs.

text.p: Ford Espana, the Spanish unit of Ford Motor Co, confirmed on Friday it had applied for permission for 21 days of temporary lay-offs for 5,766 workers on Ka and Escort models at its Valencia factory.
The request must be approved by regional authorities.
"If the request we presented around 15 days ago is approved, we will start to apply it in the last week of this month," a Ford spokesman told Reuter.
The temporary lay-offs were justified by an excess of productive capacity, the spokesman explained.
"Our production capacity is for 240,000 cars for year and we forecast the manufacture of around 200,000 this year," he said.
Unions called a 30-minute strike for each shift in protest. The first strike took place at 0830 GMT.
